summary: Validated the post-pod-reset fix for Admin → System → App Management. Backend health/config APIs are 200, the admin APK upload chunk+finish flow correctly rejects a non-matching APK (fdroid) with HTTP 400 and the exact 'does not belong to the Customer App' message, and the local storage fallback writes an APK that is byte-identical when downloaded via /api/media/file/<name> with the correct application/vnd.android.package-archive content-type. In the admin web_panel UI (built fresh with PUBLIC_URL=/api/panel/ because /app/web_panel/build was absent), the App Management page under System loads with NO 'Failed to fetch' toast; all required data-testids are present on both Customer App and Partner App tabs, and tab switching works. 6/6 backend tests passing.

issues: Recharts console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' repeated multiple times — cosmetic, no functional impact

action_items: The web_panel build output (/app/web_panel/build) was missing on this preview — I ran `PUBLIC_URL=/api/panel yarn build` to make /api/panel/ reachable. Main agent should ensure the build is produced (or served from a dev server) as part of the recurring post-pod-reset recovery, otherwise /api/panel/* returns 404 and no admin UI is reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: app_management_routes.finish_upload now correctly runs file-read and _parse_apk via anyio.to_thread.run_sync — good; no regression observed in the chunk+finish rejection path.
storage_service._put local-fallback URL (/api/media/file/<name>) returns byte-identical content with the correct APK content-type; good.

Minor: finish_upload opens the chunk file with a lambda inside to_thread.run_sync — fine, but consider streaming reads for very large APKs to avoid loading entire file into memory twice (raw bytes + S3 put).
test_credentials: Super Admin phone +919000000000 OTP 123456 (also one-click 'Login as Admin' on /api/panel/login works)
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond test. A tiny random 2KB payload was written via storage_service._put to /app/backend/uploads under app-mgmt/customer/TEST-*.apk for the download-verification test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel lives at /api/panel/ served by FastAPI from /app/web_panel/build (built with PUBLIC_URL=/api/panel). Login URL: /api/panel/login — the easiest admin path is the 'Login as Admin' demo button. App Management is under left sidebar → System → App Management. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_app_management.py and cover: public config GET, admin config auth, chunk+finish rejection with /tmp/tiny.apk (fdroid), and local-storage put+media download. Auth endpoints are /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp (not /api/auth/otp/request).
